# GitHub-safe public storefront demo — Sable & Saffron

Upload only this folder under `dist/pre-made-templates/sable-saffron-restaurant-pro-theme/` to your public static Vercel repository.

- `index.html`: static HTML rendering of the WordPress theme design; NOT a live WordPress instance
- `details.html`: honest plugin compatibility / prelaunch details
- `preview.webp`: actual screenshot of the static demo (generated during package build)
- `template.json`: metadata for `scripts/build-template-catalog.mjs`
- `assets/`: original AI-generated concept imagery included

**Do not upload or commit the installable paid WordPress ZIP to this public folder.**
